name: gemm_a8w8_blockwise_scaled_b_shuffled_row_major_a_scale_n512_k4096
description: fp8 gemm dequantized per block: a fp32 scale per 128 x 128 of b, per 1 x 128 of a, K-major or MN-major. operand_format is '<a>:<b>'; 'none:preshuffled' is aiter's 16 x 16 shuffle_weight b with a raw column-major a_scale. Set a_scale.is_row_major to pass a row-major a_scale with a shuffled b.

sources.content:
"""FlyDSL block-scaled FP8 GEMM (128x128 scale blocks), AITER 16x16 preshuffled B.

out[m, n] = sum_kb  sa[m, kb] * sb[n // 128, kb] * sum_{k in kb} a[m, k] * W[n, k]

Structure: per workgroup a (tile_m x tile_n) output tile, tile_k = 128 = one
scale block.  A goes gmem -> registers (A_DIST tiles ahead) -> LDS (in
MFMA-read order, XOR swizzled, 2 stages of LDS_GROUP K tiles each, one barrier per group), B is read
straight from the preshuffled payload into registers (B_DIST tiles ahead).  The
K loop is fully unrolled so every ring slot is static (the compact rolled
one-tile-ahead loop is kept as an option).  Tiles and pipeline depths are
chosen per m bucket in _pick_config.  Each 128-wide K tile is
one 16x16x128 fp8 MFMA per (m16, n16) sub-tile into a fresh accumulator, which
is then folded into the running fp32 accumulator with the per-row activation
scale times the per-block weight scale.
"""

import functools

import torch

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
from flydsl.compiler.kernel_function import CompilationContext
from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
from flydsl.expr.typing import BFloat16, Float8E4M3FN, Float32, Int8, Int32
from flydsl.expr.typing import Vector as Vec
from flydsl._mlir import ir
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import rocdl as _rocdl_d

M_MAX = 65536
BLOCK_K = 128
BLOCK_N_SCALE = 128
# Pipeline constants (measured on MI355X, kernel-only, m = 1 / 1024):
#   LDS_GROUP 1 -> 6.3/7.3 us, 2 -> 6.5/7.6, 4 -> 5.3/6.35, 8 -> 5.3/6.4, 16 -> 5.7/7.1
#   (A_DIST, B_DIST) at G=4: (6,4) best; (5,2) 6.1, (5,3) 6.0, (6,3) 5.9, (8,6) 5.4
LDS_GROUP = 4      # K tiles per LDS stage (one barrier per group)
A_DIST = 6         # A global->register prefetch distance (tiles)
B_DIST = 4         # B global->register prefetch distance (tiles)


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=64)
def _compile(N: int, K: int, tile_m: int, tile_n: int, G: int = LDS_GROUP,
             DA: int = A_DIST, DB: int = B_DIST, rolled: bool = False,
             KS: int = 1, WS: int = 1, NW: int = 4):
    # G : K tiles per LDS stage (one barrier per G tiles).
    # DA: A global->register prefetch distance in tiles (A(kt+G) is written
    #     to the other LDS stage during tile kt, so DA > G).
    # DB: B global->register prefetch distance in tiles.
    # rolled: incumbent scf.for loop (G=1, distance 1) for the large-m case.
    if rolled:
        G, DA, DB = 1, 2, 1
    assert DA > G >= 1 and DB >= 1
    RA = DA
    RB = DB + 1
    tile_k = BLOCK_K
    elem_bytes = 1
    layout_elem = Float8E4M3FN
    out_elem_cls = BFloat16
    SK = K // BLOCK_K

    # K tiles per (split, wave group): grid z = KS splits across workgroups,
    # WS groups of 4 waves split K again inside one workgroup (LDS reduce).
    num_tiles = K // tile_k // KS // WS
    assert num_tiles * KS * WS * tile_k == K
    assert KS == 1 or not rolled
    assert WS == 1 or not rolled
    m_repeat = tile_m // 16
    num_waves = NW
    n_per_wave = tile_n // num_waves
    num_acc_n = n_per_wave // 16
    acc_size = m_repeat * num_acc_n * 4
    total_threads = 64 * NW
    assert tile_m * tile_k >= total_threads * 16
    assert BLOCK_N_SCALE % tile_n == 0
    a_lds_elems = tile_m * tile_k
    n_scale_loads = (tile_m * SK // 4) // total_threads
    assert n_scale_loads * total_threads * 4 == tile_m * SK

    assert num_tiles % G == 0
    _ann = {f"a{i}": fx.Array[layout_elem, WS * a_lds_elems, 16] for i in range(2 * G)}
    _ann["sc"] = fx.Array[Float32, SK * tile_m, 16]
    if WS > 1:
        _ann["red"] = fx.Array[Float32, (WS - 1) * total_threads * acc_size, 16]
    SharedStorage = fx.struct(type("SharedStorage", (), {"__annotations__": _ann}))

    @flyc.kernel
    def kernel_gemm(
        arg_out: fx.Tensor,
        arg_a: fx.Tensor,
        arg_b: fx.Tensor,
        arg_scale_a: fx.Tensor,
        arg_scale_b: fx.Tensor,
        i32_m: fx.Int32,
        arg_ws: fx.Tensor,
        arg_cnt: fx.Tensor,
        tiled_copy_g2s: fx.TiledCopy,
    ):
        bid_x, bid_y, bid_z = fx.block_idx
        if const_expr(WS > 1):
            raw_tid = fx.thread_idx.x
            group = fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(
                fx.T.i32, fx.Int32(raw_tid // total_threads).ir_value()))
            tid = raw_tid % total_threads
            kt0 = bid_z * (num_tiles * WS) + group * num_tiles
        else:
            tid = fx.thread_idx.x
            group = 0
            if const_expr(KS > 1):
                kt0 = bid_z * num_tiles
            else:
                kt0 = 0

        _scale_atom = fx.make_mma_atom(fx.rocdl.cdna4.MFMA_Scale(16, 16, 128, layout_elem))
        tiled_mma = fx.make_tiled_mma(
            _scale_atom,
            fx.make_layout((1, NW, 1), (0, 1, 0)),
            fx.make_tile(None, None, fx.make_layout((32, 4), (1, 32))),
        )

        gA = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(
            arg_a,
            max_size=False,
            num_records_bytes=fx.Int64(i32_m) * fx.Int64(K),
        )
        gB = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_b)
        gC = fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(
            arg_out,
            max_size=False,
            num_records_bytes=fx.Int64(i32_m) * fx.Int64(N) * fx.Int64(2),
        )

        tA = fx.flat_divide(gA, fx.make_tile(tile_m, tile_k))[None, None, bid_x, None]
        tB = fx.flat_divide(gB, fx.make_tile(tile_n, tile_k))[None, None, bid_y, None]
        tC = fx.flat_divide(gC, fx.make_tile(tile_m, tile_n))[None, None, bid_x, bid_y]

        buf_copy = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy128b(), layout_elem)
        uni_copy = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.UniversalCopy128b(), layout_elem)

        thr_mma = tiled_mma.thr_slice(tid)
        thr_g2s = tiled_copy_g2s.get_slice(tid)
        thr_s2r = fx.make_tiled_copy_A(buf_copy, tiled_mma).get_slice(tid)
        thr_g2r_B = fx.make_tiled_copy_B(buf_copy, tiled_mma).get_slice(tid)

        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(SharedStorage).peek()
        # A tile in LDS in MFMA-read order: the 16x16x128 fp8 A operand has
        # lane l read row l % 16, k bytes [32*(l // 16), +32) as two b128
        # (k half kh = 0/1).  Offset = mi*2048 + kh*1024 + kq*256 + r16*16 + kb
        # (k = kb + 16*kh + 32*kq, row = r16 + 16*mi), so every ds_read_b128
        # reads 1 KiB contiguous.  The row-major Swizzle<3,4,3> layout (16
        # rows 128 B apart per read) left ~4 LDS conflict cycles on every A
        # read on gfx950 (624 vs 112 conflict cycles/wave at m=2048) that no
        # XOR swizzle of that layout removed.  Swizzle<3,4,4> XORs (kh, kq)
        # into r16 bits 0..2 so the g2s writes (8 lanes per row over all 8
        # 16-B k chunks) do not pile onto one bank group.  Measured A-loop
        # LDS conflicts per wave at m=2048: 0 (Swizzle<3,5,3>: 256, no
        # swizzle: 1792); graph us m=2048 10.6 -> 9.6-10.0, m=4096 14.6 -> 14.5.
        assert tile_k == 128 and elem_bytes == 1 and tile_m % 16 == 0
        swz = fx.SwizzleType.get(3, 4, 4)

        def _make_sA(arr):
            base = arr.ptr
            if const_expr(WS > 1):
                base = arr.ptr + group * a_lds_elems
            return fx.make_view(
                base,
                fx.make_composed_layout(
                    fx.static(swz),
                    fx.make_layout(((16, tile_m // 16), (16, 2, 4)),
                                   ((16, 2048), (1, 1024, 256))),
                ),
            )

        # LDS buffer index = stage * G + j  (stage = (kt // G) % 2, j = kt % G)
        sA_stages = [_make_sA(getattr(lds, f"a{i}")) for i in range(2 * G)]

        pA_g = thr_g2s.partition_S(tA)
        pA_s_stages = [thr_g2s.partition_D(s) for s in sA_stages]
        pA_s2r_stages = [thr_s2r.partition_S(s) for s in sA_stages]
        pB_g = thr_g2r_B.partition_S(tB)

        frag_copy_A_stages = [
            fx.make_fragment_like(pA_s_stages[0][None, None, None]) for _ in range(RA)
        ]
        frag_A = thr_mma.make_fragment_A(sA_stages[0])
        frag_B_single_layout = thr_mma.partition_B(tB).layout(None, None, None, 0)
        frag_B_stages = [
            fx.make_fragment_like(frag_B_single_layout, layout_elem.ir_type)
            for _ in range(RB)
        ]
        frag_C = thr_mma.make_fragment_C(tC)
        frag_P = thr_mma.make_fragment_C(tC)
        frag_A_retile = thr_s2r.retile(frag_A)
        frag_B_retile_stages = [thr_g2r_B.retile(b) for b in frag_B_stages]
        buf_copy_out = fx.make_copy_atom(fx.rocdl.BufferCopy16b(0), out_elem_cls)
        thr_r2g_C = fx.make_tiled_copy_C(buf_copy_out, tiled_mma).get_slice(tid)
        pC_g = thr_r2g_C.partition_S(tC)
        frag_C_out = fx.make_fragment_like(frag_C, out_elem_cls.ir_type)
        frag_C_retile = thr_r2g_C.retile(frag_C_out)

        # ── scale operands ────────────────────────────────────────────
        bx_m = bid_x * tile_m
        by_n = bid_y * tile_n
        lane_id = tid % 64
        lane_div_16 = lane_id // 16
        sa_rsrc = fx.rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(
            fx.get_iter(
                fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(
                    arg_scale_a,
                    max_size=False,
                    num_records_bytes=fx.Int64(i32_m) * fx.Int64(SK * 4),
                )
            )
        )
        sb_rsrc = fx.rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(
            fx.get_iter(fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_scale_b))
        )
        # Stage the block's combined scales sa[r, kt] * sb[n_blk, kt] in LDS,
        # transposed to [kt, r], once before the K loop: the K loop then reads
        # them with LDS loads (lgkmcnt) and never waits on the vmem counter.
        sb_row_byte = (by_n // BLOCK_N_SCALE) * (SK * 4)
        sS = fx.make_view(lds.sc.ptr, fx.make_layout((SK, tile_m), (tile_m, 1)))
        v4f32 = fx.T.vec(4, Float32.ir_type)
        for i in range_constexpr(n_scale_loads):
            idx4 = tid + i * total_threads
            r = idx4 // (SK // 4)
            kt4 = (idx4 % (SK // 4)) * 4
            sa4 = Vec(rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(
                v4f32, sa_rsrc, fx.Int32((bx_m + r) * (SK * 4) + kt4 * 4), fx.Int32(0)
            ))
            sb4 = Vec(rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(
                v4f32, sb_rsrc, fx.Int32(sb_row_byte + kt4 * 4), fx.Int32(0)
            ))
            prod = sa4 * sb4
            for j in range_constexpr(4):
                sS[kt4 + j, r] = prod[j]

        def load_scales(kt):
            vals = []
            for mi in range_constexpr(m_repeat):
                for ii in range_constexpr(4):
                    vals.append(sS[kt0 + kt, mi * 16 + lane_div_16 * 4 + ii])
            return vals

        acc_zero = Vec.filled(acc_size, 0.0, Float32)

        def mma_tile(a_stage, cur_frag_B, kt):
            svals = load_scales(kt)
            frag_P.store(acc_zero)
            fx.copy(
                uni_copy,
                pA_s2r_stages[a_stage][None, None, 0],
                frag_A_retile[None, None, 0],
            )
            fx.gemm(
                tiled_mma,
                frag_P,
                frag_A[None, None, 0],
                cur_frag_B[None, None, 0],
                frag_P,
            )
            elems = []
            for p in range_constexpr(acc_size):
                elems.append(svals[p % (m_repeat * 4)])
            svec = Vec.from_elements(elems, Float32)
            frag_C.store(Vec(frag_C.load()) + Vec(frag_P.load()) * svec)

        def load_A(kt):
            fx.copy(buf_copy, pA_g[None, None, None, kt0 + kt], frag_copy_A_stages[kt % RA])

        def load_B(kt):
            fx.copy(buf_copy, pB_g[None, None, None, kt0 + kt], frag_B_retile_stages[kt % RB])

        def write_A(kt):
            buf = ((kt // G) % 2) * G + kt % G
            fx.copy(uni_copy, frag_copy_A_stages[kt % RA], pA_s_stages[buf][None, None, None])

        def grouped_path():
            # ── prologue ──
            for d in range_constexpr(min(DA, num_tiles)):
                load_A(d)
                if const_expr(d < min(DB, num_tiles)):
                    load_B(d)
            for d in range_constexpr(max(min(DB, num_tiles) - DA, 0)):
                load_B(DA + d)
            frag_C.store(acc_zero)
            for j in range_constexpr(G):
                write_A(j)
            gpu.barrier()

            # ── fully unrolled K loop (all slot indices static) ──
            for kt in range_constexpr(num_tiles):
                if const_expr(kt + DA < num_tiles):
                    load_A(kt + DA)
                if const_expr(kt + DB < num_tiles):
                    load_B(kt + DB)
                mma_tile(((kt // G) % 2) * G + kt % G, frag_B_stages[kt % RB], kt)
                # A(kt+G) goes to the other stage, last read in the previous group
                # (fenced by that group's closing barrier).
                if const_expr(kt + G < num_tiles):
                    write_A(kt + G)
                if const_expr(kt % G == G - 1 and kt + 1 < num_tiles):
                    gpu.barrier()

        def rolled_path():
            # One K tile per LDS stage, A and B one tile ahead, scf.for over
            # tile pairs: the compact loop wins at m >= 4096 (4 blocks/CU).
            def step(read_stage, kt, next_k_val=None):
                write_stage = read_stage ^ 1
                do_next = next_k_val is not None
                if const_expr(do_next):
                    fx.copy(buf_copy, pA_g[None, None, None, next_k_val], frag_copy_A_stages[0])
                    fx.copy(
                        buf_copy,
                        pB_g[None, None, None, next_k_val],
                        frag_B_retile_stages[write_stage],
                    )
                mma_tile(read_stage, frag_B_stages[read_stage], kt)
                if const_expr(do_next):
                    fx.copy(uni_copy, frag_copy_A_stages[0], pA_s_stages[write_stage][None, None, None])
                    gpu.barrier()

            fx.copy(buf_copy, pA_g[None, None, None, 0], frag_copy_A_stages[0])
            fx.copy(buf_copy, pB_g[None, None, None, 0], frag_B_retile_stages[0])
            frag_C.store(acc_zero)
            fx.copy(uni_copy, frag_copy_A_stages[0], pA_s_stages[0][None, None, None])
            gpu.barrier()

            loop_end = (num_tiles - 2) // 2
            for iv, state in range(0, loop_end, 1, init=[frag_C.load()]):
                frag_C.store(state[0])
                kb = fx.Int32(iv * 2)
                step(0, kb, kb + fx.Int32(1))
                step(1, kb + fx.Int32(1), kb + fx.Int32(2))
                results = yield [frag_C.load()]
            frag_C.store(results)
            step(0, fx.Int32(num_tiles - 2), fx.Int32(num_tiles - 1))
            step(1, fx.Int32(num_tiles - 1), None)

        if const_expr(rolled):
            rolled_path()
        else:
            grouped_path()

        # Cross-workgroup split-K fixup (KS > 1).  Each thread publishes its
        # fp32 partial (thread-private slot; workspace laid out
        # [tile][z][q][tid] x 16 B so each wave access is 1 KiB contiguous
        # instead of 64 lanes 128 B apart), releases it, and bumps its own
        # per-thread counter.  The thread that arrives last for its slot sums
        # the KS partials in fixed z order (deterministic), writes bf16, and
        # resets the counter to 0 for the next launch.  Helpers hold no
        # dynamic if (the AST rewriter only handles those at kernel level).
        ws_rsrc = fx.rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(fx.get_iter(fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_ws)))
        cnt_rsrc = fx.rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(fx.get_iter(fx.rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(arg_cnt)))
        tile_id = bid_x * (N // tile_n) + bid_y
        slot = tile_id * total_threads + tid
        n_v4 = acc_size // 4
        # gfx950 cache policy sc0|sc1: system-coherent (L2-bypassing)
        # access, so no agent-scope fence (whole-L2 writeback) is needed.
        _CPOL_SYS = ir.IntegerAttr.get(ir.IntegerType.get_signless(32), 17)

        def epilogue():
            frag_C_out.store(Vec(frag_C.load()).to(out_elem_cls))
            fx.copy(buf_copy_out, frag_C_retile, pC_g)

        def publish():
            cv = Vec(frag_C.load())
            for q in range_constexpr(n_v4):
                part = Vec.from_elements([cv[q * 4 + e] for e in range_constexpr(4)], Float32)
                _rocdl_d.raw_ptr_buffer_store(
                    part.ir_value(), ws_rsrc,
                    fx.Int32((((tile_id * KS + bid_z) * n_v4 + q) * total_threads + tid) * 16).ir_value(),
                    fx.Int32(0).ir_value(),
                    aux=_CPOL_SYS,
                )
            rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
            return rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_atomic_fadd(
                fx.Float32(1.0), cnt_rsrc, fx.Int32(slot * 4), fx.Int32(0), aux=17
            )

        def final_sum():
            tot = []
            for q in range_constexpr(n_v4):
                acc4 = None
                for z in range_constexpr(KS):
                    v4 = Vec(rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(
                        v4f32, ws_rsrc,
                        fx.Int32((((tile_id * KS + z) * n_v4 + q) * total_threads + tid) * 16),
                        fx.Int32(0),
                        aux=17,
                    ))
                    acc4 = v4 if acc4 is None else acc4 + v4
                for e in range_constexpr(4):
                    tot.append(acc4[e])
            frag_C_out.store(Vec.from_elements(tot, Float32).to(out_elem_cls))
            fx.copy(buf_copy_out, frag_C_retile, pC_g)
            _rocdl_d.raw_ptr_buffer_store(
                fx.Float32(0.0).ir_value(), cnt_rsrc,
                fx.Int32(slot * 4).ir_value(), fx.Int32(0).ir_value(),
                aux=_CPOL_SYS,
            )

        if const_expr(WS > 1):
            # In-workgroup K-split reduction through LDS: groups 1..WS-1 park
            # their fp32 partials (thread-private, stride 1 in tid), group 0
            # adds them in fixed group order and runs the epilogue / fixup.
            sR = fx.make_view(lds.red.ptr, fx.make_layout(((WS - 1) * acc_size, total_threads), (total_threads, 1)))
            if group != fx.Int32(0):
                cvr = Vec(frag_C.load())
                rbase = (group - 1) * acc_size
                for i in range_constexpr(acc_size):
                    sR[rbase + i, tid] = cvr[i]
            gpu.barrier()
            if group == fx.Int32(0):
                cv0 = Vec(frag_C.load())
                acc_l = [cv0[i] for i in range_constexpr(acc_size)]
                for gg in range_constexpr(1, WS):
                    for i in range_constexpr(acc_size):
                        acc_l[i] = acc_l[i] + sR[(gg - 1) * acc_size + i, tid]
                frag_C.store(Vec.from_elements(acc_l, Float32))
                if const_expr(KS > 1):
                    old = publish()
                    if fx.Float32(old) == fx.Float32(float(KS - 1)):
                        final_sum()
                else:
                    epilogue()
        else:
            if const_expr(KS > 1):
                old = publish()
                if fx.Float32(old) == fx.Float32(float(KS - 1)):
                    final_sum()
            else:
                epilogue()

    @flyc.jit
    def launch_gemm(
        arg_out: fx.Tensor,
        arg_a: fx.Tensor,
        arg_b: fx.Tensor,
        arg_scale_a: fx.Tensor,
        arg_scale_b: fx.Tensor,
        i32_m: fx.Int32,
        arg_ws: fx.Tensor,
        arg_cnt: fx.Tensor,
        stream: fx.Stream,
    ):
        CompilationContext.get_current()

        val_per_thr = 16
        thrs_k = tile_k // val_per_thr
        thrs_m = total_threads // thrs_k
        tiled_copy_g2s = fx.make_tiled_copy(
            fx.make_copy_atom(fx.UniversalCopy128b(), layout_elem),
            fx.make_layout(
                ((thrs_k, thrs_m), (1, val_per_thr)),
                ((thrs_m * val_per_thr, 1), (1, thrs_m)),
            ),
            fx.make_tile(thrs_m, tile_k),
        )

        kp_elems = 16
        n0 = N // 16
        k0 = K // 64
        s_nlane = kp_elems
        s_klane = 16 * s_nlane
        s_k0 = 4 * s_klane
        s_n0 = k0 * s_k0
        preshuffle_B = fx.Tensor(
            fx.make_view(
                fx.get_iter(arg_b),
                fx.make_layout(
                    ((16, n0), (kp_elems, 4, k0)), ((s_nlane, s_n0), (1, s_klane, s_k0))
                ),
            )
        )
        arg_a_2d = fx.Tensor(
            fx.make_view(fx.get_iter(arg_a), fx.make_layout((M_MAX, K), (K, 1)))
        )
        arg_c_2d = fx.Tensor(
            fx.make_view(fx.get_iter(arg_out), fx.make_layout((M_MAX, N), (N, 1)))
        )

        gx = (i32_m + (tile_m - 1)) // tile_m
        gy = N // tile_n

        kernel_gemm(
            arg_c_2d,
            arg_a_2d,
            preshuffle_B,
            arg_scale_a,
            arg_scale_b,
            i32_m,
            arg_ws,
            arg_cnt,
            tiled_copy_g2s,
        ).launch(
            grid=(gx, gy, KS),
            block=(64 * NW * WS, 1, 1),
            stream=stream,
        )

    return launch_gemm


def _pick_config(m):
    """(tile_m, tile_n, rolled, G, A_DIST, B_DIST) per m bucket.

    Graph-replay kernel time on MI355X (us), K=4096, N=512:
      m=4096: 32x64 rolled 18.6 | 64x64 grouped(4,6,4) 18.0 | 32x128 grouped 17.0
              64x128 grouped (G,DA,DB)=(4,6,4) 16.0, (4,6,3) 15.5, (2,4,2) 14.9,
              (2,4,1) 15.0, (1,2,1) 15.3 | 64x128 rolled 22.6 | 128x128 25.4
      m=2048: 32x64 grouped(4,6,4) 10.9 | 64x64 grouped (4,6,4) 10.7, (2,4,2) 10.4,
              (2,3,2) 10.9 | 32x128 11.7 | 64x128 12.5+ | rolled paths 13+
              (but in the harness, 64x64 (2,4,2) measured 22.6 vs 32x64 22.25,
              so m=2048 stays on 32x64)
      m<=1024: 32x64 grouped (4,6,4) (64x64, 128x64, 32x128, ... slower).
    32x32 tile, NW=2 waves x WS=2 (256 WGs at m=512), cold-L2 graph replay (us):
      m=512:  canonical 32x64 (4,6,4) WS1 18.8-19.0 | 32x32 NW2 WS2 (2,5,2) 17.15-17.3,
              (2,5,3) 17.15, (2,4,2) 17.25-17.5, (2,4,3) 17.26, (4,6,4) 17.6, (2,6,3) 17.37,
              (4,5,3) 17.96, (2,3,2) 19.8, (1,2,1) 21.6 | NW2 WS1 19.5 | NW1 WS4 17.8,
              NW2 WS4 17.7  (harness m=512: 15.10-15.16 vs 32x64 16.05)
      m=1024: 32x32 NW2 WS2 (2,5,3) 20.9, (2,5,2) 21.2 vs canonical 19.7 (2 WGs/CU loses)
    With the in-workgroup K split (_pick_wsplit), single-replay graph timing
    (harness-like: one call per replay, A re-copied before each; us):
      m=4096: 64x128 (2,4,2) WS1 26.0-26.2 | WS2 (2,4,2) 25.1-25.5, (2,3,2) 25.0-25.2,
              (1,2,1) 25.4, (1,3,2) 25.6, (2,4,1) 26.3, (2,3,1) 26.7 | 64x64 WS2 30.9+
      m=2048: 32x64 (4,6,4) WS1 21.7-22.2 | 64x64 (2,4,2) WS1 22.0, WS2 21.4-21.6,
              (2,3,2) WS2 21.8, (4,6,4) WS2 21.8 | 64x128 WS2 23.4 | WS4 22.2+
    """
    if m >= 4096:
        return 64, 128, False, 2, 3, 2
    if m >= 2048:
        return 64, 64, False, 2, 4, 2
    if 512 <= m < 1024:
        return 32, 32, False, 2, 5, 2
    return 32, 64, False, LDS_GROUP, A_DIST, B_DIST


# Cross-workgroup split-K factor per m bucket: (max m, KS); larger m -> KS=1.
# Harness per-case us with the lane-contiguous workspace (noise ~0.3-0.7 us):
#   m<=32: KS4 14.0-14.7, KS8 13.9-14.4, KS16 14.3-14.9
#   m=64: KS2 14.9-15.1, KS4 14.4, KS8 14.0-14.6
#   m=128: KS1 15.5, KS2 15.2, KS4 14.3-14.7, KS8 14.3-14.9
#   m=256: KS1 15.3-15.6, KS2 15.3-15.6, KS4 14.3-15.0
#   m=512: KS1 15.7-16.0, KS2 15.8-15.9, KS4 16.2-16.5
#   m=1024: KS1 16.8, KS2 18.3-18.5 (64x64 KS2 18.8-19.3)
KS_MAP = ((64, 8), (128, 8), (256, 4))


def _pick_ksplit(m):
    for th, ks in KS_MAP:
        if m <= th:
            return ks
    return 1


def _pick_wsplit(m):
    # K split across 4-wave groups inside one workgroup (LDS reduction).
    # Single-replay graph us, WS=1/2: m=1024 16.9/17.1, m=128 (back-to-back
    # graph) 5.90/6.04, m=64 5.83/5.95, m=32 KS2+WS2 5.85 vs KS4 5.58: the
    # small-m buckets are bytes-per-CU bound, so a second wave per SIMD only
    # adds the reduction.  It pays at m >= 2048 (see _pick_config).
    # m in [512, 1024): WS=2 with the 2-wave 32x32 tile (see _pick_config),
    # 17.2 us vs NW2 WS1 19.5 us -- the second group fills the idle SIMDs.
    if m >= 2048 or 512 <= m < 1024:
        return 2
    return 1


def _pick_nw(m):
    # Waves per K group (each wave owns tile_n // NW output columns).  The
    # 512 <= m < 1024 bucket runs 32x32 tiles with 2 waves x WS=2 groups so
    # gx*gy = 256 workgroups cover every CU (32x64 left half of them idle).
    if 512 <= m < 1024:
        return 2
    return 4

    *, m, n=512, k=4096, sn=4, sk=32
):

    ks = _pick_ksplit(m)
    ws_ = _pick_wsplit(m)
    nw = _pick_nw(m)
    tpg = k // 128 // ks // ws_
    if ks * ws_ > 1:

    exe = _compile(int(n), int(k), tile_m, tile_n, G=g, DA=da, DB=db, rolled=rolled, KS=ks,
                   WS=ws_, NW=nw)
    n_tiles = ((m + tile_m - 1) // tile_m) * (n // tile_n)
    # Split-K workspace (fp32 partials, thread-private slots) and per-slot
    # arrival counters; the counters self-reset, so they are zeroed only once.
    ws = torch.empty(max(1, n_tiles * 256 * ks * (tile_m * tile_n // 256)) if ks > 1 else 4,
                     dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
    cnt = torch.zeros(n_tiles * 256 if ks > 1 else 4, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")

    def launch(a, b, a_scale, b_scale, out):
        mm = a.shape[0]
        exe(
            out.view(-1),
            a.view(torch.int8).view(-1),
            b.view(torch.int8).view(-1),
            a_scale.view(-1),
            b_scale.view(-1),
            mm,
            ws,
            cnt,
            fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream()),
        )

    return launch

    build_gemm_a8w8_blockwise_scaled_blk128x128_nt_obfloat16_bshuf16x16_aslogical_n512_k4096_module
